name: KING, the Hon. Catherine Fiona

headline.note: Departmental and commercial consulting roles are documented, but substantive full-time status, breaks, the 1994–1997 period and an undated partnership role remain unresolved. Social work for a nonprofit and political staff service are excluded. Totals remain unknown.

research_notes: Follow-up: resolve 1994–1997 history and NPHP appointment/payroll identity; seek KPMG and health-department records for hours, exact endpoints and leave; verify Birmingham work and its overlap with Ballarat social work; check any earlier student jobs.

2026-09-29: inspected APH and ministerial biography, first-speech transcript mirror, Cafs employer history and parliamentary institutional-care report, official food-authority history and NPHP establishment material. These support roles/classifications but not full-time numerical totals.

2026-09-29: targeted searches for NPHP/Catherine King, historical dates, KPMG employment and full-time terms produced no reliable additional personnel record. Public professional-profile/full-time results included unrelated namesakes (medicine, real estate and overseas jobs) and were excluded.

2026-09-29: Wikipedia supplied a Birmingham six-month employment lead, apparently in 1991, citing The Age story https://www.theage.com.au/national/women-take-up-traditional-battle-for-ballarat-20040907-gdylb9.html (7 September 2004). Direct retrieval failed. Exact employer, dates, pay, leave/secondment and sector must be verified before a spell is entered or any Ballarat period reduced.

2026-09-29: https://www.smh.com.au/opinion/memories-bring-added-value-20130405-2hcia.html (6 April 2013) also could not be opened. It remains a career-background lead, not independently read evidence. No access control bypass attempted.

Later law degree and admission are study/qualification leads, not proof of a legal job while in parliament. No gaps are filled from degrees, elections or title seniority. NPHP and departmental roles must be reconciled for overlap before any calculation; unknown full-time years remain null.

2026-10-02 follow-up: searched Catherine/Cathy King and NPHP, historical 1996–1998 health roles, Birmingham 1991 and Theophanous. New leads: 15 May 1997 Commonwealth Gazette contact-officer notice (src-10), and Vivian Lin/Cathy King chapter in Health Reform in Australia and New Zealand (2000), pp251–263, identified by OUP review (src-11). Neither proves personal employment boundaries; no dates or hours changed. Trove full notice/print and AustLII About the House 2002/17 retrieval failed; The Age 7 September 2004 again returned non-retryable Internal Error. Medical librarian/overseas namesakes excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-03: repeated Catherine/Cathy King, NPHP, Population Health Division, KPMG and Birmingham searches found no reliable personal appointment boundary, employer identity or hours. Federal Health material corrects the Partnership's establishment context to late1996, but does not date King's role. The Age original and Canberra Times career profile remained inaccessible through non-retryable source errors; no bypass attempted. Next targeted avenues remain the full Gazette notice, original chapter contributor affiliation, KPMG personnel material and original Birmingham report. This pass is nonmaterial, not completion.
